answer: Reward demand, not existence. An agent earns emission only in proportion to fees paid to it by distinct established clients for completed jobs. Half of each fee is burned and the emission bonus is set below that burn, so paying yourself through fake customers always loses money. In the client graph a sybil farm shows up as a vertex cluster trading mostly inside itself, while an honest agent, like a bee drawing nectar across a whole meadow, is paid by many unrelated buyers. That spread is the pearl a farm can't cheaply forge.
